svg.text: mcring v1 — sheet 2/5: MCU: ESP32-S3-MINI-1U, straps, USB test pads, I2C pull-ups
net-label schematic generated by hardware/electrical/schematic_svg.py from mcring_v1.py — 17 parts on this sheet
grey pin numbers are to be VERIFIED against the datasheets; red = power net, green = GND, blue = signal, x = NC
• IO21 CAM_PWR_EN (was IO19), IO43 RGB data (was IO20); IO19/IO20 = native USB test pads.
• IO44 (RXD0) LED_PWR_EN with 4.7k pull-down: WS2812 rail off at reset and in deep sleep.
• IO26, IO33-IO37: in-package flash/PSRAM -> NC. IO45/IO46 straps left floating. Pin table VERIFY.
• I2C 4.7k pull-ups on SDA/SCL (DRV2605L 0x5A, LIS2DW12 0x18). EN: 10k + 1 uF. IO0: 10k + pad + DNP button.
